ai.seo_question: What does it mean that divine decree is unending and unforbidden?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah, affirming that all blessings and decrees are entirely dependent on His will, neither cut off by chance nor withheld arbitrarily. It highlights the concept of *Tawhid* in action, where the believer recognizes that no resource or favor is independent of the Divine source, reinforcing trust in God's continuous provision.
